newsitem.title: JAPAN: Teikoku Oil unit finds new gas field off Japan.
newsitem.headline: Teikoku Oil unit finds new gas field off Japan.

text.p: Exploration firm Teikoku Oil Co Ltd said on Monday its subsidiary Offshore Iwaki Petroleum Co Ltd had found a new gas field off Japan's Pacific coast.

Offshore Iwaki Petroleum sank a test well earlier this year in an area about 34 km off Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, and the well flowed about 300,000 cubic metres of natural gas per day at a depth of 2,400 metres last week, a Teikoku Oil spokesman said.
The area is a few kilometres southwest of an existing gas field that produces about 200 million cubic metres of natural gas a year, he said.
Offshore Iwaki Petroleum will decide on the feasibility of commercial production at the field after a seismic survey, and possibly some more test drillings, reveal potential reserves at the field.
The seismic survey, and test drillings if necessary, will be carried out in fiscal year starting next April, he added.
